'''Arljack''', nicknamed '''"Arl"''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a medical technical at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After a duel between [[Rance Lussk]] and [[Wim Nickter]], who was kidnapped by [[Darth Scabrous]], Arljack was present with several patients.
